summary: Website for internal user guides/solutions: engineers can browse solutions and publish blog-style solution posts; support users can view guides; admin manages user accounts (usernames/passwords) and can edit/publish updates.
architectural_notes: Support seeding an initial Admin user account (configurable default credentials) for first-time access.
known_issues: Prior build/deploy attempt failed ('AI was unable to fulfill your request'); needs retry after applying requested changes.

existing_features.title: Add authentication flows using admin-managed usernames and passwords: login, logout, and session handling. Ensure role information is available to the frontend to enforce permissions.
Create core end-user pages to browse and read published user guides/solutions: a home/listing view (with basic filters like tag and/or text search) and a post detail view.

Enable Engineers to create and publish blog-style solution posts, including a 'My posts' view and an editor for creating/updating content. Enforce that Engineers can edit/delete only their own posts, while Admin can edit/delete any post.

Provide an Admin console to manage users (create users, set/reset passwords, assign roles, deactivate/reactivate accounts) and to manage content (create/edit/publish/unpublish posts and post updates).

Add consistent, coherent UI theme and layout for a knowledge-base style portal (choose a distinct visual direction with typography, spacing, and neutral color palette; do not use blue/purple as primary colors). Apply the theme across public browsing, editor, and admin console.
Generate and include required static image assets and render them in the frontend from static files under frontend/public/assets/generated.

Update the frontend sign-in experience so an administrator can log in using the seeded credentials (username "Rushikesh", password "123") via the existing username/password authentication flow (not Internet Identity), and ensure all user-facing login text remains in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a user guide/solutions website where engineers can browse solutions and user guides
Allow engineers to create and publish blog-style solution posts
Implement authentication with admin-managed user accounts (usernames/passwords)
Role-based access: support users can view user guides/solutions; admin has full editing/publishing permissions
Admin interface to edit content and post new updates

Implement backend data models and persistent storage for: (a) users with roles (Admin, Engineer, Support) and admin-managed credentials (username + password hash), and (b) solution/guide posts with title, body (rich text or markdown-like plain text), tags, author, created/updated timestamps, and publish status (draft/published).
Seed/set default Admin account credentials (username: Rushikesh, password: 123)

Seed/set the default Admin account credentials to username "Rushikesh" and password "123" in the backend’s admin-managed username/password authentication system, ensuring the account has the Admin role and can be used to sign in after deployment/upgrade.

projectName: User guide & solutions portal with role-based accounts and publishing
